answer: Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 20%. Because the ferrous pair is tracked in the orchard ledger, the wander audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 163 identities means 163 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
